needs.premise: One context, two abstract canonical root cells, two collection epochs, one nested callback and independent worker2; frame/denv root completeness and platform binding are premises; no real handler, stop or C weak-memory proof

22 conditional declarations: coverage composition, active/frozen duty Step/Trace conservation, relocation reload, reentry exclusion, activation and view lifetime; no induction over all QNT actions or C simulation

Point-specific live roots include exported GVM registers, saved values, type caches, frame/denv roots, host locals and all RC domains; address/location coverage, lifetime and writable relocation slots required; no arbitrary C-stack inference

At a qualified safepoint spill live values, close ordinary root/payload writers and raw Scheme borrowers, pin frame/root locations; publish descriptor and NativeFrozen membership together; frozen locations permit collector writeback
Active mutator ack becomes a frozen-root obligation in the same phase gate; collection includes every context generation exactly once; worker identity is independent of context or processor count
Role-qualified worker owns writable canonical cells and relocation completion; moving roots updated in place or through proved writeback mapping; global collection/mutator barriers remain required

Reentry request closes new round admission, honors already-enlisted pending/in-flight root scans, validates current epoch/roots/binding and grants active participation before reload; no second scan may race protected reload; metadata pins retire after use

Acquire callback permission before RC payload/marker access, root proc before allocation, retain suspended parent activation roots, publish fresh parent view on callback exit; unknown writers, closure identity or nonlocal exit reject transfer

Release/acquire descriptor, scan completion and phase-gate publication must order root stores and reload; no racing plain C root loads or lock-free/liveness claim; generation wrap and aliases need platform refinement

Publish qualified native participation and frozen context roots before acceptance; no-escape raw-enter through ready publication: cancellation/handler policy established before acceptance; no Scheme checkpoint, callback, logging, foreign unwind or local-only result ownership; OS preemption remains allowed

Before restoring masks/cancellation or propagating Scheme errors: release gate, publish outcome, retain result/root in stable service and restore VM/processor binding; stopped owner recovery needs independent scan/stop evidence
Every live RC data slot belongs to the next scan census, including retained donors; splice and scan exclude concurrent mutation
Reserved scratch extent covers allocation, all exits and reload; nested saved writers cannot clobber it
Real PSTATE, effective binding, VM and catcher restore are separately established on every admitted exit
Still preparation, foreign cleanup, native borrower drain and retained capacity charged exactly once before backing release

Initial relation, every real source action/stutter, concrete observation reflection and progress; claim/initialize/publish/acquire/scan/rescan/finish; source Tail and partial-copy states require extra relation

rootCosts.removedWork: Remove admitted pure-native contexts from active ack waiting, retain their root tasks
rootCosts.bound: For N contexts and K qualified frozen contexts: active ack targets N-K; root obligations still N
rootCosts.addedCost: Membership ledger and explicit phase admission per transition
rootCosts.condition: No runtime speedup or bounded native-call time; other managed contexts/global collector still coordinate

rootCosts.removedWork: Adopt canonical spill/RC/frame cells instead of duplicating all values
rootCosts.bound: Entry metadata O(D+U) if block descriptors and existing spills suffice; value-copy mode O(R)
rootCosts.addedCost: Descriptor blocks D, additional exported locals U, frame/root pins
rootCosts.condition: Coverage and writable canonical mapping must be proved; no universal constant-time freeze

rootCosts.removedWork: Reload relocated values under active permit; no repeated native operation required
rootCosts.bound: Reload O(U) live exported locals; existing frames/RC cells updated in place
rootCosts.addedCost: Epoch/binding check, scan drain, activation root bank and callback marker
rootCosts.condition: Permission precedes first Scheme read; publication alone is not a callback token

rootCosts.removedWork: No existing root traversal proved removable by freezing
rootCosts.bound: Required scan work remains O(R); view creation does not reduce live root count
rootCosts.addedCost: Exclusive relocation-cell authority and per-epoch acknowledgement
rootCosts.condition: A stale detached root copy fails even when it kept the object alive

rootCosts.removedWork: Pure-native code can run without managed payload access
rootCosts.bound: Bcopy bytes for copied input/output buffers; opaque handles retain root obligations
rootCosts.addedCost: Copy/encoding work and buffer backing may raise peak
rootCosts.condition: Raw pointers into STILL payload do not certify graph stability or race freedom

rootCosts.removedWork: Keep parent continuation/denv/host roots valid during callback
rootCosts.bound: Retained memory includes all suspended parent frame/root spans until their pins drain
rootCosts.addedCost: O(A) activation descriptors plus live retained spans for A nested activations
rootCosts.condition: Do not add independent maxima as measured whole-round peak

rootCosts.removedWork: Allow root scan with unknown native result only when root-writer closure remains independently valid
rootCosts.bound: Root scan can be admissible while operation handoff remains denied
rootCosts.addedCost: Unknown writer/binding/closure identity or dead-held gate keeps custody and can block progress
rootCosts.condition: No automatic corruption detection, general owner-death recovery or allocator-progress guarantee

rootCosts.removedWork: Reuse Scheme liveness/FrameSpec generation, C root cells and FFI conversion machinery
rootCosts.bound: Zero additional Zig runtime-work reduction established
rootCosts.addedCost: Modern C still needs activation banks, canonical RC domains, phase tokens and ordering proofs
rootCosts.condition: Language replacement does not establish coverage or safe native access

nodes.labelText: Safepoint spill + root coverage\nclose writers / raw borrowers
Publish canonical root view\ntransfer ack -> frozen-root duty
Pure native bytes / opaque IDs\nno Scheme payload access
Independent worker scan lease\nwrite relocated canonical cells
Return / callback reentry request\nhonor owed scan; close new rounds
Drain scan; validate latest epoch\ngrant active participation
Reload roots / protect callback proc\nthen marker and Scheme execution
Callback exit exports result\npublish fresh parent view
Unknown writer / stale binding\nretain custody; refuse transfer

callers.actualChain: Scheme resource-set generator -> R/W_ALL spill/reload; C-fun context saves RA and writes locals to PSTATE
callers.hazard: Spill macros are not a participation transition or coverage of arbitrary C locals
callers.replacement: Reuse generated resource/liveness selection; add explicit safe-point/root/membership contract

callers.actualChain: SAVE1/2/3 -> three PSTATE slots -> GC mark_saved -> RESTORE and clear
callers.hazard: Nested activation may reuse same three slots; standalone copied value can become stale
callers.replacement: Activation-scoped host-root bank or equivalent proven spill stack; never infer all C locals covered

callers.actualChain: I/O macros write type_cache; setup clears root arrays; GC scans processor object
callers.hazard: Not all PSTATE words are Scheme roots; temp1..4 and pc require point-specific classification
callers.replacement: Root descriptor distinguishes pointer, scalar, RA and unboxed materialization states

callers.actualChain: Frame GC maps and break frame -> captured continuation; restore rewrites thread denv/caches
callers.hazard: Collector rewrites frame links/slots; callback can change dynamic environment; frozen values are not immutable
callers.replacement: Pin locations/FrameSpec; give collector write authority; reload/reconcile before running

callers.actualChain: mark_array copies/forwards objects and writes updated reference to *cell
callers.hazard: Scanning a detached value copy without canonical writeback leaves C locals/RC payload stale
callers.replacement: Exclusive cell relocation lease plus completion epoch; no concurrent ordinary read/write

callers.actualChain: alloc_rc/register_rc link to current PSTATE; set_data_rc writes data; release/addref/data access use raw header
callers.hazard: mark_rc is invoked only from processor0 branch; plain list/refcount/data operations have no freeze permission
callers.replacement: Canonical RC root domain per owner; enumerate every domain; migrate write/borrow/delete admission

callers.actualChain: DoOneEvent/Tcl callback -> data_rc -> tcltk_call; delete callback releases data and header
callers.hazard: Payload read precedes C-to-Scheme marker; deletion can race scan/in-flight callback; still vector children can move
callers.replacement: Opaque callback identity/header lease first; reacquire before data_rc; deletion retires through root service

callers.actualChain: SFUN wrapper obtains PSTATE then allocates marker, writes proc/processor ID, calls Scheme and invalidates marker
callers.hazard: Source root-protection TODO before marker allocation; raw callback proc cannot survive arbitrary GC
callers.replacement: Activation token and proc root before marker allocation; result/root custody before release

callers.actualChain: Scheme string conversion allocates RC native byte buffer then C operation
callers.hazard: Conversion itself reads Scheme data and must run while active; scheme-object FFI arguments remain managed references
callers.replacement: Finish copy/handle conversion before FrozenNative; pure-native uses bytes plus opaque IDs only

callers.actualChain: C closure stores global c_closure_self, converter recovers procedure from RC data
callers.hazard: Explicit source TODO for thread locality; TLS alone does not restore identity after nested callback
callers.replacement: Per-thread and per-activation identity/restore stack; reject unsupported generated trampoline profile

callers.actualChain: thread_set_pstate updates binding; call rewrites GVM fp/self; global roots partition by processor count
callers.hazard: PSTATE binding is not a mutator permit; old partition cannot be reinterpreted as independent worker count
callers.replacement: Explicit context generation, worker work-context and separate global/root ownership

callers.actualChain: Collective setup/strong/weak/cleanup barriers; retiring PSTATE cleans still/RC state
callers.hazard: Root image does not eliminate global moving-GC coordination or authorize early frame/RC free
callers.replacement: Preserve phase obligations; scan/return pins and stop evidence precede metadata/root facility withdrawal
